description: This source file implements the AwsFileStore class, which provides an implementation of the IFileStore interface for Amazon S3 storage, including methods for file and directory management such as get, create, delete, move, copy, and stream access.

classes.name: AwsFileStore
classes.description: Implements IFileStore for Amazon S3, providing file and directory operations such as get, create, delete, move, copy, and stream access.

methods.name: GetFileInfoAsync
methods.description: Retrieves metadata for a specified file from S3.

methods.name: GetDirectoryInfoAsync
methods.description: Checks if a directory exists in S3.

methods.name: GetDirectoryContentAsync
methods.description: Enumerates contents of a directory, optionally including subdirectories.

methods.name: TryCreateDirectoryAsync
methods.description: Attempts to create a directory in S3.

methods.name: TryDeleteFileAsync
methods.description: Attempts to delete a file from S3.

methods.name: TryDeleteDirectoryAsync
methods.description: Attempts to delete a directory and its contents from S3.

methods.name: MoveFileAsync
methods.description: Moves a file within S3 by copying and deleting the original.

methods.name: CopyFileAsync
methods.description: Copies a file within S3 from source to destination.

methods.name: GetFileStreamAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a stream for reading a file from S3.

methods.name: CreateFileFromStreamAsync
methods.description: Creates a new file in S3 from a stream, with optional overwrite.

methods.name: NormalizePrefix
methods.description: Utility method to normalize S3 key prefixes.
